name: horse-browser
description: The control board for the Horse Browser — the dedicated browser your agents drive (vendored harness included): setup/status tiles, the enforced Bitwarden credential broker, a real compositing probe + DeskPad lid-closed vision, the live process wall, and the docs agents load. A compact hero links to the full story.

atelier.note: Nothing required up front — the board reads the machine and degrades gracefully; it doubles as a first-run setup guide. Its buttons install the stack: @pa1nd/horse-browser via npm (postinstall builds the vendored harness venv) and DeskPad via brew for lid-closed vision. The Bitwarden credential broker (native Swift daemon in native/, signed + launchd) needs the Bitwarden CLI (bw) + Swift/Xcode Command Line Tools; it compiles on first run into ~/Library/Application Support/hb-broker (outside the module tree). The display census (CoreGraphics via python3 ctypes, ioreg), DeskPad, and the broker are macOS-only; those probes report nulls elsewhere and the compositing check still works against any CDP on 127.0.0.1:9223 (override with HB_CDP_PORT).
